places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: At the Dry Bean saloon Jake charms Lorena, bathes in her room upstairs and wins her; afterward she stops taking customers.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande; the Dry Bean saloon has rooms upstairs and a back porch

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Jake guesses it is where Lorena belongs and promises to help her get there; they discuss routes.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Jake tells Lorena he killed a dentist there and is wanted by the law.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Lorena bought her now-fraying dresses there and has refused offers from men to take her back, since it lies the wrong way.

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Cowboys working along it, including Jasper Fant, hear that Lorena has quit her trade.

groups.label: Lorena
groups.hint: at the Dry Bean saloon, waiting for Jake to come back

groups.label: Jake Spoon
groups.hint: rode south with Call's party after his afternoon with Lorena
